subject.title: feat: add per-conversation whatsapp debounce config

question: Should OpenClaw ship the bounded WhatsApp-owned `groups/direct.<conversation>.debounceMs` contract, or first adopt the generic plugin debounce-policy direction proposed in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106458?
rationale: Both open PRs solve the same user need through different permanent public surfaces, and selecting one determines the configuration and plugin extension contract that future channels must follow.

options.title: Sponsor the WhatsApp-owned setting
options.body: Treat per-conversation batching as WhatsApp-specific configuration, require redacted real-account proof, and review this smaller surface for merge.

options.title: Prefer a generic plugin contract
options.body: Adopt the plugin-policy direction first and close or rework this PR so operators do not receive two competing debounce mechanisms.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the WhatsApp-owned setting
recommendation.body: Treat per-conversation batching as WhatsApp-specific configuration, require redacted real-account proof, and review this smaller surface for merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidenced author of both competing designs; a repository owner must make the final product decision.
